selection: Evenly spaced nonempty source rows; concatenate subsequent rows with newline until 257 tokens, take first 257. No generated feedback.
calibration_objective: Per-layer relative output MSE on deterministic calibration activation rows. No held-out tuning.

formats.activation: INT8 symmetric dynamic per-token row after SmoothQuant rescaling
formats.requantization: FP32 dequantization to FP16; no integer M/r contract
formats.kv: native FP16 unless separately labeled state perturbation
formats.recurrent_state: native FP32 unless separately labeled state perturbation
formats.convolution_state: native FP16 unless separately labeled state perturbation
formats.nonlinear_attention_gate_norm_residual: native floating point; not end-to-end integer

scope: Local diagnostic candidate, not the final project precision contract. Do not adjust acceptance after inspecting validation. Fake quantization timings excluded from performance claims.
